candidates.title: Google DeepMind: teams of Gemini 4 agents discover cheaper quantum algorithms, each proved correct and costed in a new open-source Lean 4 library (290x arcsin, 11.8x fusion, 8x photochemistry, 2.5x P450, up to 2.57x parallel Grover)
candidates.reason: Weighted 87.9. >= 80 but rejected as out of window. The DeepMind blog and X announcement are in window (X post 2026-11-23T17:00:53Z), but the underlying paper arXiv 2611.09822 was public from v1 on 2026-11-06T18:08:06Z (v2 11-09, v3 11-16) and v1 already reported the 290x arithmetic, 11x fusion, 8x photochemistry and 2.5x drug-metabolism results; the v3 abstract names Gemini 4 and raises parallel search to 2.57x. The Lean library repo (Apache-2.0, created 2026-11-14) had its single public commit on 2026-11-17T02:29:29Z. Not found in any earlier candidate file, so it was missed by earlier runs; flagged to Jason, not written (same rule as the 11-16 OpenAI/arXiv case). Verified on the official blog: 11.8x cost cut and 5,650 -> 4,338 logical qubits for an inertial-confinement-fusion quantity, P450 481 -> 333 qubits; DeepMind notes these remain beyond first error-corrected machines and are not hardware demonstrations.

candidates.title: Einsia RoboUniverse-10K: 10,807 resettable, verifiable Isaac Sim environments built from real robot videos (4,132 Franka + 6,675 AgileX), a 500-task RoboUniverse-Verified benchmark, and an open RoboUniverse-35B-A3B model
candidates.reason: Weighted 78.7. < 80 (closest in-window candidate). In window: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-11-23T16:53:57Z and announced in the 2026-11-24 cs.RO listing; project page last-modified 2026-11-24T07:27Z; GitHub repo (Apache-2.0) and HF repos were created 11-22/11-23 but updated and announced on 11-24. Verified from the abstract and repo: Harbor-compatible harness with hidden verifiers, 11 models evaluated (frontier best 85.8% vs open-source 2.6-10.0%), SFT of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on ~17K GPT-6 Astra trajectories (0.79B tokens) lifts RoboUniverse-Verified from 0.8% to 21.2%; code, dataset and 36B safetensors weights are public and ungated. Mainly a benchmark/environment contribution from a young lab; all numbers author-reported; sim-to-real shown on a single Franka task, which keeps breakthrough and credibility below article level.
